events.name: Western Lake Erie 2014 Bloom
events.description: The 2014 Lake Erie bloom forced Toledo's 'do not drink' advisory affecting 500,000 residents for three days. BloomCast hindcast demonstrates 7-day lead time before satellite confirmation.

events.name: Lake Zurich 2022 Bloom
events.description: Severe cyanobacteria bloom on Lake Zurich triggered beach closures. BloomCast hindcast shows 5-day predictive lead time.
events.source: Amt für Abfall Wasser Energie und Luft (AWEL) Kanton Zürich

events.name: Lake Vembanad 2019 Bloom
events.description: Severe bloom on Lake Vembanad, Kerala, linked to post-monsoon nutrient loading. BloomCast hindcast shows 6-day lead time.
events.source: Kerala State Council for Science Technology and Environment
